_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

study_areas.basis: study areas, from 'spread across 32 areas' and 'the same 32 study areas'

prior_survey_year.basis: the year of the manual survey the project repeats

survey_year.basis: the year of the automated survey

field_months.basis: computed: calendar months October to December inclusive

review_checks.basis: computed: the checks the review makes on each detected dog (unrestrained, supervision, number present, owned or stray)

classes.basis: computed: the two labels a free dog can get, stray or roaming
